## R15. Where the delegation default lives (owner ruling 2026-11-01)

The owner's choice: the delegation default must not be in `AGENTS.md`, because
subagents load `AGENTS.md` too and would delegate onward by default. It lives
in the `mvp-mode` router, scoped to the top-level agent, and ships with the
plugin; rule R2 is amended to allow a router rule that differs between the
top-level agent and a delegate. The previous row's `rewording` also inverted
the ruling: "work locally on small tasks and wherever delegation has no clear
advantage" makes local work the default; the ruling needs a clear advantage
for local work.

The trait `delegate-by-default` now opens "At top level," so the router line
matches it whole (T5). The row compares with `mvp-mode`, which lists it: the
fact is `variant` via `delegate-by-default`, delivered at
`.claude/skills/mvp-mode/SKILL.md:35-39`. `AGENTS.md` now defers to the
router for when to delegate and keeps only the delegate's rule (delegate
further only when the brief allows it); its conditional `delegation-threshold`
line is gone.

Guide check: `ok`. U-07 asks to say when delegation improves the result; the
line says when local work is better instead, which bounds the same decision.
C-14 keeps small tasks and verification local: the line keeps verification,
coordination and integration with the top-level agent and names small work (a
handful of tool calls, a known lookup) as local. C-14's "delegate only
sizeable tasks" is narrower than "delegate by default" for mid-sized work;
that residual difference is the owner's stated choice, not a guide conflict.
